player_prompt.intro:
Oli mchezaji {player_id} mu mupiira gwa Connect Four.
Akabandi kya gwe: {symbol}.
Bodi ya mupiira ina {num_rows} safu na {num_cols} safu wansi.
Abazanyi bazanyira kwa zamu kuteeka kabandi kwabwe mu safu wansi zamu (0 hadi {end_col}).
Asinga kugwa nnya kabandi kwe kikomo, wansi, oba diagonally awangula.
Ku zamu yako, ingiza nambari ya safu wansi mu kabokisi ya mraba ili ukole omulimo gwo.
Ekyokulabirako: '[col 4]' oba '[col 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Omuzannyi {player_id}, Muundo wa kuzannyisa si wa buli. Gwali gwali gwali: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Omuzannyi {player_id}, Ekikolwa kyo tekirungi. Ekisanja {col} kiri ku ngalo.
invalid_move.already_full: Omuzannyi {player_id}, Kuzannyisa kibafu. Kikolwa {col} kiri ku bukya.

action.dropped_disk: Omuzannyi {player_id} yaweereza diski ye ({player_symbol}) mu kikolwa {col}.
